name: Second buyer-cohort expansion
hypothesis: Buy a range break only when later-window buyers are mostly absent from the first cohort and funded from diverse sources.
spec: Setup: A second distinct cohort may matter more than first-block activity. Entry: Buy a range break only when later-window buyers are mostly absent from the first cohort and funded from diverse sources. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on second-cohort net selling or a failed range break. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs launchpad creation events, bonding-curve state and decoded swaps (on-chain history not connected)
